decision: R2337: reset-to-default tabs via LB_SETTABSTOPS frees the pixel position array. OpenNT usercli.h 1154 and current usercli.h 1185 both map UserLocalFree to HeapFree, which returns nonzero on success. Original inverted predicate retains a stale array pointer after successful free and clears it on failure. Existing real heap control fails with original predicate and passes with selected one. Keep just the one-line polarity correction pending.
